text: Final categorization: EXCLUDED (Justification: The paper is not a review article about LULC future prediction. As a non-review research paper, it fails the core inclusion criteria. The land cover change data used are historical observations from remote sensing to drive the model, not future projections. The paper does not implement or compare multiple future LULC scenarios.)
